name: Hy4 Flash
archDisplay: Fast, low-cost sibling of Hy4 with retained deep thinking and image understanding; architecture and size not stated on Tencent's pages; 1M-token context
note: Tencent's Hy4 Flash, listed on Tencent Cloud TokenHub on Nov 16, 2026 (model list and price pages last updated that day) as model hy4-flash: 1M context, 960K max input, 64K max output, retained deep thinking, structured output, function calling, caching and image understanding, the same limits as Hy4. List price is $0.07 input / $0.281 output / $0.003 cached per Mtok (Hy4 is $0.834/$2.501); a 50% launch discount through Nov 30, 2026 is promotional and not filed. Hy4 Flash is a smaller sibling of Hy4, not its successor, so predecessor is null. The launch post (hunyuan.tencent.com/research/hy4-flash) renders client-side and could not be read, so the 224B total / 12B active parameters, planned open weights and benchmark figures reported by the press (HLE with tools 55.2, APEX-Agents v1.1 63.1, DeepSWE v1.1 64.6, Terminal-Bench 4.0 19.2 and others) are unverified and not filed. Not on Vals AI yet.
